messages:
Alex (Infra Ops): FYI vendor called — partial allocation confirmed for 12 H100s, ETA bumped to Thu 04:00 UTC, 6 units shipping now, 6 on backorder. Need decision on depot handoff vs direct to clusters.
Maria (Procurement): Thanks Alex. Do we have pricing delta for split shipment? Vendor said +3% per air AWB for split. If we push direct-to-cluster we lose depot inspection buffer.
Anne @Vendor: Confirmed. We can do 6 immediate air AWBs, remaining 6 on sea (ETA +9 days). We can include prepaid RMA labels for DOA up to 7 days, otherwise we charge return freight.
Sanjay (Fleet): If 6 go straight to clusters we need serial preflight + BIOS image validation. Warehouse can do QA but adds 24h. Are clusters able to accept unpacked shipments?
Kyle (Warehouse): We have a two-dock window Thu 08-18. Can do inspect/manifest + intake for 6 units same day if AWB arrives before 09:30 local. After that it pushes to next day. No spare bay for bulk thermal testing.
Maria (Procurement): Anne — can vendor consolidate RMA returns to a single EU depot? It helps customs paperwork and reduces brokerage.
Anne @Vendor: Yes we can consolidate returns to FRA depot (Anne Logistics Hub). However customs reclassification may apply if returned as "Used" vs "Defective"; that could add fees. We'll provide commercial invoice flagged as RMA to mitigate.
Alex (Infra Ops): Important: our SLA for Dedicated customers expects <50ms scheduling latency. Can't have half the pool unprovisioned. Option A: accept 6 now to relieve pressure, route to depot for QA, then direct to clusters after inspection. Option B: hold all until full batch arrives to avoid split customs. Thoughts?
Sanjay (Fleet): Option A preferable. We can enable temporary soft-capacity by routing low-priority jobs to regional pool. But we need serial manifest asap for asset tagging.
Maria (Procurement): Cost check: split shipment surcharge +3% + possible customs fee (~€1.2k) vs delayed revenue impact from slower onboarding. I'd pick Option A unless vendor insists on large surcharge.
Anne @Vendor: Surcharge for split is firm at +3% per AWB. For customs we can pre-file HS codes and provide certificate to reduce inspections; that removes most of the extra fees but requires 48h lead.
Kyle (Warehouse): On manifest: we need `AWB`, `serial`, `model`, `FW` columns. Sample snippet I need from vendor:
```
AWB123456789, SN: H100-XYZ123, H100, FW: 1.04.2
AWB123456790, SN: H100-XYZ124, H100, FW: 1.04.2
```
Alex (Infra Ops): Anne — can you send the CSV manifest 24h before arrival? And provide the prepaid RMA labels PDF?
Anne @Vendor: Will send manifest by Wed 04:00 UTC and RMA PDF with barcoded labels. Also attaching provisional AWB numbers now: AWB123456789 / AWB123456790 / AWB123456791 (3 per AWB).
LogisticsBot: Shipping notice — AWB AWB123456789 now in transit, expected Thu 02:30 UTC, carrier = RedFreight Air. Tracking: https://trk.redfreight.example/AWB123456789
Sanjay (Fleet): Quick check — for DOA flow, do we want immediate replacement workflow (vendor sends replacement ASAP) or depot-refurb then replace? Which minimizes downtime?
Maria (Procurement): Replacement ASAP adds vendor cost but preserves customer SLAs. We need to negotiate credit if DOA rate > 2%. Anne — can vendor commit to 48h replacement window for DOA units?
Anne @Vendor: We can commit to 48h replacement for DOA within region if replacements available in EU pool. For out-of-stock cases we provide loaner units (not H100 spec parity) or expedite from APAC at cost.
Alex (Infra Ops): Ok — action items: (1) Anne send manifest + RMA PDF by Wed 04:00 UTC, (2) Procurement to accept +3% split surcharge and pre-file HS codes, (3) Warehouse to standby Thu 08:00 local for intake, (4) Fleet to prepare asset tags and soft-capacity plan.
Kyle (Warehouse): Ack. I reserve dock slot Thu 08:00-12:00 for intake. Please confirm final AWB arrival window.
Maria (Procurement): I'll sign off on the +3% unless customs pre-clear adds >€2k. I'll notify finance for provisional cost center.
Anne @Vendor: Manifest & RMA PDF scheduled. Will update if any AWB shift. :thumbsup:
Alex (Infra Ops): Thanks everyone. If DOA >2% we escalate to vendor credit review. I'll ping here once warehouse confirms intake.
LogisticsBot: Update: AWB AWB123456790 delayed +3h due to airport congestion. New ETA Thu 05:30 UTC.
